Primary Duties: Issue certified copies of vital records
Related Records: Application for Certified Copy of Vital Record
Personal Data in the Records: Applicant's name, address, phone number, relationship to individual on record, reason for request, identification, payment information
Use of Personal Data: Applicant submits application and payment to clerk, clerk verifies information and issues certified copy of vital record
Purpose of Processing Personal Data: To provide individuals with legal proof of vital events
Primary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 26B-8-125, a vital record is only open for inspection in compliance with this statute and DHHS rules
Secondary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 26B-8-125, a vital record is only open for inspection in compliance with this statute and DHHS rules

Related Records: Birth certificates, death certificates, marriage certificates, divorce decrees
Personal Data in the Records: Individual's name, date and place of birth, parent's names, cause of death, marriage details, divorce details
Use of Personal Data: Clerk receives vital records, verifies information, and files records appropriately
Purpose of Processing Personal Data: To maintain accurate and complete records of vital events
Primary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 26B-8-125, a vital record is only open for inspection in compliance with this statute and DHHS rules
Secondary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 26B-8-125, a vital record is only open for inspection in compliance with this statute and DHHS rules

Personal Data in the Records: Applicant's name, address, date of birth, citizenship status, party affiliation, identification number
Use of Personal Data: Applicant submits completed voter registration application to clerk, clerk verifies information and registers voter
Purpose of Processing Personal Data: To maintain accurate and up-to-date voter registration records
Primary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 20A-2-101, voter registration records are protected and not subject to public inspection
Secondary Classification: Public, Utah Code § 20A-2-101, voter registration records are public unless designated as private by the voter

Related Records: Absentee ballot application, absentee ballot envelope
Personal Data in the Records: Voter's name, address, signature, reason for absentee voting
Use of Personal Data: Clerk receives absentee ballot application, verifies eligibility, issues ballot, receives voted ballot in sealed envelope
Purpose of Processing Personal Data: To facilitate voting for individuals unable to vote in person
Primary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 20A-3-201, absentee voter information is protected and not subject to public inspection
Secondary Classification: Exempt, Utah Code § 20A-3-201, absentee voter information is protected and not subject to public inspection
